'''Chaenia''' is an island country in the central [[Ubrana Sea]]. Situated in [[West Mahea]], its cultural identity and geopolitical orientation are overwhelmingly [[Seytinemas|Seytinemasi]]. Chaenia is the only major island in the [[Ubrana Sea]] and is the most populous island in the [[Ubrana Sea|Ubrana]]. It's mainland provinces border [[Seytinemas]] to the north and [[Dual Cenryia]] to the south, while the island borders [[Otiiric]] to the south and [[Eparia]] to the west. Its capital is [[Lutur]] and its largest city is [[Tibokan]]. Chaenia hosts the military bases of: [[Ashain]], [[Areoix Lie]], [[Dahe]], [[Easuhura]], [[Emara]], [[Lycroa]], and [[Raledria]]. The state of [[Mirran]] is de facto governed by the [[Republic of Mirran]], which is Autonomous from the Republic of Chaenia.

Chaenia was first settled by [[wikipedia:Hunter-gatherer|hunter-gatherers]] around 40,000 years ago, with [[wikipedia:Wheat#Early_farming|farming]] communities emerging by 1200 BC. The late [[Bronze Age]] saw the emergence of [[Keleissi Culture|Keleissi]], an urbanised society closely connected to the wider [[Ubrana Sea|Ubrana]] world. Chaenia experienced waves of settlement by [[Ankarra|Ankarrans]] at the end of the 2nd millennium BFA. Owing to its rich natural resources (particularly [[wikipedia:Copper|copper]]) and strategic position at the centre of the [[Ubrana Sea|Ubrana]], the island was subsequently contested and occupied by several empires, including the [[Ankarr Kingdom]] [[Trian Empire]], and the [[Lieas Invasions|Lieas]]’s from whom it was seized in 333 BC by [[Trian Empire|Trian]].

Successive rule by [[Trian City States]], the [[Folite Invasions|Folite’s]], [[Anir Kingdom]], the [[Seytinemas Kingdom]], followed by over three centuries of an independent [[Wenin Republic|Republic]]. Chaenia was placed first under [[Vesozata|Vesozara]] administration in 1533, then [[Taval|Tavaln]] administration in 1589, [[Siana|Sianan]] administration in 1592, and formally annexed by [[Emara]] in 1593. Gaining its Independence in 1703 AFA after the Red War.

From the early 1710s, Chaenia saw rapid [[wikipedia:Economic_growth|economic growth]] and [[wikipedia:/Industrialisation|industrialisation]] known as the "[[Chaenian Miracle]]". In the late 1720s and early 1730s, its government transitioned from a [[Taltinople|corrupt one-party state]] under martial law to a [[wikipedia:Multi-party_system|multi-party democracy]], with democratically elected presidents beginning in 1733. Chaenia’s export-oriented economy is the [[List of countries by GDP (nominal)|45th-largest in the world by nominal GDP]] and the [[List of countries by GDP (nominal) per capita|28th-largest by per capita]] measures, with a focus on [[wikipedia:/Steel|steel]], machinery, [[wikipedia:Electronics|electronics]], and chemicals manufacturing. Chaenia is a [[wikipedia:Developed_country|developed country]] with an advanced [[List of countries by GDP (nominal) per capita|high-income economy,]] a [[List of countries by Krali Total Development Index|high standard of living]], and robust [[wikipedia:Welfare_state|social welfare policies]]. Chaenia culture and society are broadly progressive, [[wikipedia:Egalitarianism|egalitarian]], and [[wikipedia:Social_liberalism socially liberal]]. Chaenia was the third country to legally recognise [[wikipedia:Same-sex_marriage|same-sex partnerships]]. It is a founding member of the [[SOAQ]], the [[EISA]], and is part of the [[free Schwa movement area]]. Chaenia maintains close political, cultural, and linguistic ties with its [[Trian Culture|Trian]] neighbours. The [[Chaenia political system]], which emphasises broad consensus, is used by Sunsokuan political scientist [[Dra Ider Rakel]] as a reference point for incredible institutions; his phrase "getting to Chaenia" refers to the country's status as a global model for stable social and [[wikipedia:Political_system|political institutions]].
